newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rupee steady vs dlr, seen firm on reserves.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rupee steady vs dlr, seen firm on reserves.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened steady at 57.10/12 rupees per dollar on Thursday, dealers said.
The rates are likely to remain unchanged for some time as dollar reserves held by banks have fallen, a delaer said.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.
Inter-bank call money rates opened at 3.00-4.00 percent on Thursday, against its previous close of 4.00 percent, a dealer said.
